name: dma_copyfromflashtomemory_init
description: DMA_CopyFromFlashToMemory_Init (LL): DMA1 channel 1 copies 32 words from the flash to the SRAM in memory-to-memory mode; once the transfer-complete interrupt has come, the program compares the two buffers and lights LD2 when they match (it blinks LD2 on a mismatch or a transfer error).
